provenance.paper_title: Streaming Video Understanding and Multi-round Interaction with Memory-enhanced Knowledge

representation_paths.memory_component: short-term feature set and long-term feature-caption tree

evidence.paraphrase: Short memory retains selected vision embeddings; long memory clusters chunk features and captions into a chronological tree for cosine-similarity retrieval.

representation_paths.memory_component: long-memory captions and encoded dialogue history

evidence.paraphrase: Text clues index long-memory visual units, while prior question-answer pairs are encoded into a FAISS-indexed dialogue memory.

The memory-formation thread refreshes short memory, builds long-memory tree nodes, and appends dialogue records under a fixed schedule. For StreamChat, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of short-term feature set and long-term feature-caption tree.

Chunk captions and higher-level grouped captions provide progressively compressed summaries. For StreamChat, this specifically supports episodic or hierarchical summarization of short-term feature set and long-term feature-caption tree.

Age-dependent probabilities select a fixed number of embeddings for the new short-term set; unselected candidates leave the active memory. For StreamChat, this specifically supports explicit deletion or eviction of stored items of short-term feature set and long-term feature-caption tree.

derived.hybrid_relation: Caption clues retrieve the corresponding stored visual feature units, which are supplied together with short memory.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 6): During inference, the operative memory component (short-term feature set and long-term feature-caption tree) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, episodic or hierarchical summarization, explicit deletion or eviction of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
